theme: 3 terms on moving data between apps: copy and paste, picking something up, and accepting a drop

terms.definition: A shared place where the system keeps copied data, so you can paste it in another app.
terms.example: Write the invite link to the Pasteboard when the user taps Copy.

terms.definition: An object you add to a view so that the user can pick it up and drag it.
terms.example: Add a Drag Interaction so users can drag the photo to another app.

terms.definition: An object you add to a view so that it can accept something the user drops on it.
terms.example: Add a Drop Interaction to accept files from the Files app.

video.title: Pasteboard, Drag Interaction & Drop Interaction | Day 125
video.description:
Learn to explain how iOS apps copy, drag and drop data: Pasteboard, Drag Interaction & Drop Interaction, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Pasteboard - A shared place where the system keeps copied data, so you can paste it in another app.
Drag Interaction - An object you add to a view so that the user can pick it up and drag it.
Drop Interaction - An object you add to a view so that it can accept something the user drops on it.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: iOS Pasteboard, Drag Interaction & Drop Interaction | Day 125
landscape.description:
Explain Pasteboard, Drag Interaction & Drop Interaction in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
페이스트보드, 드래그 인터랙션, 드롭 인터랙션 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Pasteboard - A shared place where the system keeps copied data, so you can paste it in another app.
한국어: 페이스트보드: 복사한 데이터를 다른 앱에 붙여 넣도록 시스템이 보관하는 공유 공간

Drag Interaction - An object you add to a view so that the user can pick it up and drag it.
한국어: 드래그 인터랙션: 사용자가 뷰를 집어 끌 수 있게 뷰에 붙이는 객체

Drop Interaction - An object you add to a view so that it can accept something the user drops on it.
한국어: 드롭 인터랙션: 사용자가 놓은 항목을 받을 수 있게 뷰에 붙이는 객체

landscape.hook: Can you explain Pasteboard, Drag Interaction and Drop Interaction in English?

dialogue.title: Copy it or drag it

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, can users copy a note into another app?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Write its text to the Pasteboard, like in the code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And on iPad, can they drag it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add a Drag Interaction to the note view.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does that also let them drop a file into our app?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No. For that, add a Drop Interaction.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So a Drag Interaction sends data out, and a Drop Interaction takes it in.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. Each interaction needs a delegate.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I used the same `handler` for both.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is fine. But the Pasteboard is simpler for small text.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: When should I choose a Drag Interaction then?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: When users expect to move things between apps, like photos.
Copy the link to the Pasteboard.
